data.display_title: Close material-partition and independent-control evidence loopholes

head_commit.message:
Close material-partition and independent-control evidence loopholes

Use one summed nonnegative intersection budget for each complete material pair, bind cached enclosures to actual native objects, and expose independent physical control and telescope inputs with explicit domains. Add a full-participant continuous fixed-pose verifier and a separate stdlib CI reader that reconstructs unique pair coverage, raw dispositions, source closure and the locked runtime.

Preserve exact e76 execution receipts: 1506 tests across all 36 suites, all ten original native jobs and 37 commands, EP4 rejection evidence, and complete EP5 nominal readbacks. Record newly reconstructed L2 matrices, the frozen 2560-column partial response, actual resource limits and reproducible numerical source. Keep all physical, full-motion, contact-convergence and release gates explicit; the new 1558-test configuration awaits its own committed-source validation.
